sn35.210-212:1.1: Cakkhum bhikkhave anattā atītam anāgatam paccuppannaṃ || yad anattā taṃ Netam mama neso ham asmi na meso attāti || Evam etaṃ yathābhūtam sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ || || Sotaṃ || || Ghānaṃ || || Jivhā || || Kāyo || || Mano anattā atīto anāgato paccuppanno || Yad anattā taṃ Netam mama neso ham asmi na meso attāti || Evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ || || Evam passaṃ || pe || nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātāti || ||
